author: Unity
description:
Create and manage Unity projects directly from your terminal, no Hub required.

Install the Unity CLI, then add the Unity Pipeline package in your project to drive a live Editor from terminal or agent: run Play mode, execute tests, trigger recompiles, and get structured JSON back.

🔗 Install the Unity CLI + Pipeline package: https://on.unity.com/UnityCLI_Docs

#Unity #UnityCLI
title: Introducing the new Unity CLI

author: Unity
description:
Bunny Blitz is a classic 2D platformer featuring a lively 3D character racing through a 2D environment. All the 3D and 2D elements are cohesively illuminated with 2D lights and use out-of-the box components to create a unified gameplay experience.

Bunny Blitz is made in Unity 6.5, and the full project is available for free on the Asset Store. You can read more about the features and techniques in the Asset Store description.

🔗 Download this 2D/3D sample from the Unity Asset Store: https://on.unity.com/BunnyBlitz_AssetStore
🔗 Ask your technical questions, share your levels, or engage with the community in our Bunny Blitz Discussions thread: https://on.unity.com/BunnyBlitz_Discussions
🔗 2D game art, animation, and lighting e-book: https://on.unity.com/2D_GameEbook
